cases.name: startup: AES loaded from the boot folder, menu bar and desktop icons
clicking icons selects and deselects them
double-clicking the boot drive opens its listing window
arrows scroll, clicks and cursor keys select rows
File:Close (Ctrl-W) closes the window and frees its listing
Desk:About shows an alert and restores the desktop exactly
Options:Launcher replaces the desktop with the card launcher
double-clicking a SEQ file opens it in the Editor as a document (the Files contract)
when the desktop returns, the AES session reopens its windows (rectangle, scroll, selection)
double-clicking a PRG hands it to the dispatcher (device 8) without a document request
a SEQ file starting with UPNT opens in Paint as a document (the signature decides, as in Files)
a drive window lists its directory sorted by name
View sorts by type, size (largest first), directory order and name; the item is checked
Show Info (Ctrl-I) opens a dialog for the selected entry; Esc restores the window exactly
the Drive 9 icon opens a second, staggered window over the first
Show Info on a drive icon: files, blocks used, and blocks free from the drive's listing
a click in the slider track pages down (clamped to the last page)
dragging the thumb to the top of the track scrolls to the first entry
clicking the lower window tops it
a drive that cannot be read gives an error alert and opens nothing
four folder windows open at once; a fifth is refused with an alert
Show Info shows a locked file as read-only (a disabled, checked box)
Show Info renames: the edited name is sent as R0:NEW=OLD and the drive is listed again
renaming onto an existing name shows the drive's refusal and changes nothing
Ctrl-D asks first (Cancel is the default), then scratches the file and lists the drive again
a file dropped on Trash is confirmed; a locked file the drive skips is reported, not hidden
dragging a row onto Trash deletes it after confirmation
names with DOS pattern characters, a busy command channel and a failed OPEN are refused with alerts
Preferences: a checkbox, a radio group, Tab and cursor focus; clicking Cancel changes nothing, OK applies the sort order
with Confirm deletes off, Ctrl-D deletes at once
Preferences: a desktop colour repaints the desktop and its icons
Options:Save Desktop writes DESKTOP.INF (preferences, colour, windows)
a cold start (AES loaded fresh) reads DESKTOP.INF: windows, sort, colour, confirm setting
the 9 key opens drive 9; File:Format asks for drive, name and ID, confirms, sends N0:NAME,ID and lists the drive again
drive 9 is read in the geometry its DOS names on UI (1581 D81, 1571 D71, another drive D64), asked once
a missing GDDLG.PRG gives an alert and the desktop goes on
a directory over 195 entries lists its first 195 (the 16-page snapshot)
the USB icon appears when the Ultimate answers; folders open in the window, the close box goes up
a USB file launches with its full path (past 16 characters); Show Info shows its name and size from FILE_STAT
USB Show Info: a folder, names over 29 characters on two lines, "..." past 58, 32-bit sizes, "1 byte"
Delete on USB: confirmed, DELETE_FILE then FILE_STAT (82) before listing again; a full folder is refused; a .txt file opens in the Editor with its folder
a USB file starting with UPNT opens in Paint, even when named .txt (the signature first, as Files)
the 80-column mirror: startup, a window, a dialog, a menu and an alert match the VIC surface on the VDC; launching restores the VDC
ALT+cursor moves the pointer 8 pixels and ALT+Return clicks; the keys are not delivered
Control Panel: key repeat goes to the KERNAL, double-click speed to the AES
